args.title: Saltmarsh Foods newsletter: Retail returns logistics
args.body:
- Newsletter: This week's Saltmarsh Foods newsletter covers retail returns logistics, linking to a blog article and a companion piece (it also promotes team-licence access via URL parameters, which I didn't need to use).
- Article (blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/returns): Apparel return rates reached 24%; consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth.
- Companion piece (insights.saltmarsh.example/returns/companion): Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
